elements.title: 2014 NFC Championship Game (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Green Bay Packers lost the 2014 NFC Championship Game and a spot in the Super Bowl after they were considered to have a 99.9-percent chance of victory?

elements.title: Thokchom Chandrasekhar Singh (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that politician Thokchom Chandrasekhar Singh was jailed for 12 months for protesting in favour of restoring the Manipur Legislative Assembly?

elements.title: Qizil Tugh (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the newspaper Qizil Tugh (Red Banner) provided a publishing platform for young Uyghur-language poets and writers in the Soviet Union?

elements.title: Gail Damerow (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Gail Damerow was described by one magazine as "poultry's Cesar Millan"?

elements.title: Kazansky District (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that both Catholic and Orthodox Christian democrats received a higher share of votes in Kazansky District than in any other district of Petrograd in the 1917 Russian elections?

elements.title: Jordan Watkins (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that in a 2024 game, college football player Jordan Watkins scored an Ole Miss–record five receiving touchdowns – even though he had never before had more than one?

elements.title: a book about them (Wikipedia — did you know?)
